examples.label: Stay dates in a booking form
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} class="max-w-md space-y-5 rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 p-6 dark:border-neutral-700">
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Check availability <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 opacity-70">Two nights minimum. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before you arrive.
<.component component_name="chelekom-date-time-field" site="Global" id="booking-check-in" name="booking[check_in]" value="" label="Check in" floating="outer" space="small"> <:start_section> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-calendar-days" class="size-5 opacity-60" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-date-time-field" site="Global" id="booking-check-out" name="booking[check_out]" value="" label="Check out" floating="outer" space="small"> <:start_section> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-calendar-days" class="size-5 opacity-60" />
<:actions> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary" size="small" full_width>Search rooms

examples.label: Event scheduler with a date and start and end times
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} class="max-w-lg space-y-5 rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 p-6 dark:border-neutral-700"> <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Schedule the workshop <.component component_name="chelekom-date-time-field" site="Global" id="event-day" name="event[day]" value="" type="date" label="Date" floating="outer" space="small"> <:start_section> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-calendar" class="size-5 opacity-60" />
